notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, Japanese GAAP (Annual Securities Report translation). Interest paid, interest and dividends received and income taxes paid are all inside OCF. Time-deposit and securities movements are in investing and are excluded from capex. The FY2025 working-capital distortion (inventory built ahead of the Nintendo Switch 2 launch) has largely unwound: inventories rose only 27,591 in fiscal 2026, while trade receivables rose 74,786 on much higher sales, which lowers OCF and raises paidOut somewhat.
